items.title: Dave Williams Interview, 1974-03-28
items.q: I played gigs with George. ... I worked with George. I worked in George Band.

ctx.x: Yeah. Yeah. That's where, uh, uh, George Lewis used to play back there, how you call it?
Sure, George Lewis, oh, George Lewis played all around in that. I guess even before I was born.

Manny's was back there, Manny's Tavern. That was in Lover's Land? Yeah, Manny's Tavern and Lover's Land. That's right. And how you call it, uh, uh, there was a restaurant back there, uh, to drive in, and I, Wallace and Raoul's was right over the Elver Pass. You remember Wallace and Raoul's?

items.title: Dave Williams Interview, 1961-07-02
items.q: Interviewer mentions George Lewis played at the Dream Room; Interviewee confirms 'That's right.'

ctx.x: Played a little drum. You remember, you used to call this place the, you know the Dream Room? Yeah. They had another man for it, and Mr. Johnny had it.
Oh yeah, I can't think now. I remember once George Lewis played there for a while and then a band from Dayton, Ohio was now.
